observations: Rubric section 6 table lists board pilot Ø 2.0-2.2, but requirements L2.3.3 (A9, M2 self-tap) says 1.6-1.8; graded against requirements.md (1.70 passes). Robin should fix the rubric table.

The corner lid bosses (Ø6.6 at (-3.787,-3.787) etc.) protrude about 0.21 mm into the inner cavity corners (inner corner at (-1.6,-1.6) is 3.09 from the boss axis); harmless, the lid lip is notched (Ø7.11) to keep 0.25 mm clearance.

The rubric's end-wall-slab aperture recipe also picks up the four blind lid-screw/boss-pilot holes (X -4.0..-2.085 and 72.085..74.0, Z 8.1-16.6) because the bosses overlap the wall corners; they do not reach the cavity and are screw holes, so they were not counted as port openings.

layout.json carries grid_residual 2.876 although the Pico header pins sit exactly on the A7 grid (residual 0.000); the large value presumably comes from the grid-exempt PJ-320A terminals. Worth renaming or documenting.
PJ-320A's real 2.0 mm Ø5 nose (noted in part.json) is not in the catalogue body; it would extend to X 72.0, into the Ø8.81 wall hole (fits). Not graded.
Margins are thin by design: KO-BOT 0.10 mm, screw-head columns 0.10 mm, plug clearances 0.10 mm over the limit. Any regression in wall/floor placement will flip these.
